description: This file defines the WorkDay class, which provides functions to calculate dates that are a specified number of working days before or after a given date, excluding weekends and holidays. It includes methods for both incrementing and decrementing dates based on working day calculations, and handles arrays of dates for batch processing.

classes.name: WorkDay
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate workdays before or after a given date, considering weekends and holidays. Supports batch processing via array arguments.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Calculates a new date by adding or subtracting a number of workdays from a start date, excluding weekends and specified holidays. Supports array inputs for batch calculations.

methods.name: incrementing
methods.description: Private method to increment a date by a number of workdays, adjusting for weekends and holidays.

methods.name: incrementingArray
methods.description: Private method to adjust an end date considering holidays within a date range, ensuring holidays are excluded from the workday count.

methods.name: decrementing
methods.description: Private method to decrement a date by a number of workdays, adjusting for weekends and holidays.

methods.name: decrementingArray
methods.description: Private method to adjust an end date backward considering holidays within a date range.

methods.name: getWeekDay
methods.description: Private helper method to get the weekday of a given date, used to adjust dates around weekends.
